blocking_findings.title: Signed sender can choose another tenant for new outcome
blocking_findings.reproduction: The route verifies one global LEAD_CAPTURE_HMAC_SECRET, then accepts organizationId from the signed body. The new outcome writer is passed that body value and only checks that the supplied location belongs to that same chosen org. A holder of the shared signing secret can submit a valid call for any existing org and create its lead and outcome there, contrary to K2.
blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Bind each signing credential to one organization on the server and derive the outcome and lead organization from that credential; reject a conflicting body organization.

blocking_findings.title: Replay creates another Lead for the same call
blocking_findings.reproduction: On every delivery this transaction creates a new Lead before recordLocalOutcome reports duplicate. Replaying one signed externalId therefore leaves two Lead rows while only the outcome is deduplicated; the J7 known-gap note explicitly included the duplicate Lead case.
blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Add a unique org/provider/event key to Lead or an ingestion ledger and return the existing lead on replay within the transaction.

blocking_findings.title: Call and booking accepted without an outcome
blocking_findings.reproduction: For phone_call, booking, or direction_request with no primary GBP location, or a supplied location from another org, kind is set but locationId is null. This branch persists the lead and line 259 returns 200 ok with outcome.status skipped, so the sender will not retry and M4/M5 loses the event.
blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Reject with an explicit non-2xx status until a verified location can be resolved, or persist a recoverable pending outcome and report that state honestly.

blocking_findings.title: Signed call payload can store audio or transcripts
blocking_findings.reproduction: The P6 intake still accepts rawPayload as an unrestricted record and leadArgs stores body.rawPayload verbatim in Lead.rawPayload. A signed call/booking body containing audio, recording URL, or transcript fields is persisted despite K11 requiring event metadata only and no call audio or transcripts. New P6 outcome handling does not sanitize this existing storage path.
blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Allowlist metadata fields for call and booking intake before the Lead write; reject or strip audio, recording, and transcript content and add a negative persistence test.

blocking_findings.title: Review outcome failure is reported as successful sync
blocking_findings.reproduction: A failed recordLocalOutcome is reduced to a warning after GBPReview.upsert and reviewsSynced increments. The cron then returns success:true and failed:0, so a lost review outcome is invisible to its caller and will not be retried as a failed job.
blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Track outcome failures in the cron result and return a failing or explicitly partial status that triggers a retry or durable recovery.

blocking_findings.title: Listing drift outcome failure is hidden behind 200
blocking_findings.reproduction: When drift is detected but recordLocalOutcome throws, this catch only logs. The route still returns a normal 200 NAPAuditResult with mismatches, and its new unit test asserts this behavior, so the P6 outcome write can be silently lost.
blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Surface outcomeRecorded:false with an unavailable/partial contract and non-2xx status where needed, or queue a durable retry; test the failure response.

blocking_findings.title: Rank outcome failure is hidden behind snapshot success
blocking_findings.reproduction: The new outcome write runs after keywordRankSnapshot.upsert and snapshotCount++. This catch logs and continues, so takeRankSnapshot returns a successful count even when no rank outcome was recorded; the cron cannot detect or retry the missing event.
blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Return an explicit partial/failure result or durable retry record and include outcome success in the cron status.
